verdict.rationale: Beamer documents its own feedback collection and prioritization, a public roadmap, and in-app installation via an embed code, so it has the feedback capability this story depends on. The evidence never explicitly describes a shareable feedback-portal URL or an in-product link that routes users to it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a feedback portal URL or link, instructions for adding a link or button in-product that opens the portal, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal

citations.quote: Now, you can easily collect and prioritize feedback—and know how to build more value into your product.
Install in five minutes](/install) with a simple embed code or Wordpress plugin.
